mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, which may increase cenobamate plasma concentrations, while cenobamate induces CYP3A4 creating a complex bidirectional interaction.
action: Monitor cenobamate efficacy and adverse effects; consider dose adjustment if cimetidine is initiated or discontinued; alternative H2-blockers (famotidine) may be preferred.
